OriginBenefit.Name: Twofer
OriginBenefit.Effect:
You gain one benefit from each of the two animals you =;ve chosen as your combined altmode 
 Behemoth: Increase your health by 1, Additonally add 10 ft to your Altmodes Ground Movment. 
 Carapaced: Increase your Toughness by 1. 
 Climber/ Nimble: Increase your Evasion by 1. You also gain a Climb Movement 30 feet. 
 Flora: Increase your Health by 1. 
 Flyer: you gain an Aerial Movement of 40 feet. You also gain ↑1 on Alertness Skill Tests related to vision. 
 Insecticon: Increase your Toughness by 1, and you gain ↑1 on Brawn Skill Tests. 
 Many-Armed: You gain ↑ 1 on Acrobatics or Alertness Skill Tests. Monstrous: you natural weapon attacks gain the Accurate (↑1) Trait. 
 Primate: Increase your Willpower by 1. 
 Quadruped You gain ↑1 on Skill Tests that predominately utilize your senes of hearing or smell. Additionally, add 10 feet to your Alt Mode Movement. 
 Suarian: You are Immune to Poison damage and effects. 
 Slitherer: Increase your Cleverness by 1. 
 Swimmer: You gain an Aquatic Movement of 40ft. Additionally your melee and natural weapons gain the Amphibious trait.
